# Accordion

Stacked sections that expand and collapse without leaving the page.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Content first</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-accordion--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:content-first;mode:light" title="Accordion examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-accordion--docs">Open Accordion in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-accordion--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:content-first;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Content first:** Questions and answers in guides.

- **Use it when:** Optional detail, questions and answers, grouped content people may skip.
- **Not when:** A decision that blocks the page, a side panel, or a hint on hover.

Instead:

- [Tabs](./tabs.md): Peer views of the same thing, one at a time.
- [Collapsible](./collapsible.md): A single section, not a stack.
- [Dialog](./dialog.md): A blocking decision.

## Words

- Write to one person: "you", not "users".
- Short sentences with room to breathe.
- Explain why before asking for anything.
- Use: Read, Save for later, You, Next issue. Avoid: Click here, Submit, Users, Content.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Browse guides

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Enter or Space opens and closes the focused section. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] Each header is a button inside a heading and says whether it is open. undefined

## Look closer

<div class="odv-anat-link"><a href="./accordion-anatomy">Anatomy reference →</a><span>Each part of Accordion, and how the design decisions reach it: the answer, the rule, the token and the value you see.</span></div>

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add accordion
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Accordion reads 16 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Accordion's tokens to change Accordion alone.
